CZR.gist: A stock pulling back in an uptrend, above support.

against.head: A lower high and a lower low
against.text: Its last swing high and swing low each came in under the one before.
against.learn: Falling swing highs and lows are the steps of a downtrend.

against.head: Strong downtrend (ADX 37)
against.text: Trend strength (ADX) reads 37, above the 25 that marks a strong trend, with sellers in control of the directional lines.
against.learn: A 0-100 gauge of trend strength, not direction; above 25 is a strong trend.

against.head: Momentum stuck in a bear range
against.text: RSI has failed below 58 on every bounce for three months and fell to 16: the range momentum holds in a downtrend.
against.learn: In uptrends RSI tends to hold 40 on dips and reach 70; in downtrends it fails near 60 and reaches 30.

material.head: Pullback in an uptrend
material.text: Price has dipped below its 50-day average but holds above the rising 200-day, with the 50-day above the 200-day.
material.learn: A dip inside an uptrend; buyers often return at support.

material.head: −5.8% from its 52-week high
material.text: The 52-week low is 63% under the price.
material.learn: The highest price of the past year; above it, no one who bought in the last year is waiting to sell at breakeven.
